children.name: Ricordea florida Duchassaing & Michelotti, 1860
children.description: Ricordea florida is a species of coral of the family Ricordeidae and the order Corallimorpharia, whose members are also called false corals.

children.name: Ricordea yuma
children.description: Ricordea yuma is a species of coral in the family Ricordeidae, order Corallimorpharia; This order of corals do not produce the distinctive calcification of the closely related Scleractinian, or reef building corals.
